notes.title: Another Big Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Engine Version!! [/b][/h2]
I updated from Unreal 4.19 to 4.26. This came with a lot of things to fix but will allow me to use more engine features and plugins. This also seems to have effected physics a bit so the carnival games will play a little differently. 

[h2][b]Changes/Additions[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Changed wall and ceiling colors in apartment. 
[*]Updated the lighting again for all the maps.
[*]Added a more proper controls board in the starting room. 
[*]Added collisions around maps so players can't walk outside the play area.
[*]Added a bounding box around play area. If a player is outside of it for 5 seconds they'll be teleported back to the play space. 
[*]Changed the spectator screen away from a full screen capture. This will increase performance. 
[*]Set the controller model to a more generic one rather than being a Vive controller. 
[*]Holding the grip buttons will reset player position to starting location. 
[*]Changed the drone glow color to yellow in the shooter mini game. 
[*]Added a new text effect when a drone is destroyed. 
[*]Changed the amount of bottles knocked to reset from 12 to 8. With the physics change and the removal of a ball it made it pretty difficult to get to 12. 
[*]Some new easter eggs ;) 
[/list]

[h2][b]Steam Leaderboards [/b][/h2]
Added leaderboard support. You'll find the leaderboards in game in the shooter game and in the carnival at ring toss and the bottle knock games. If I get more time I may add in filters for friends only, and possibly pages. 

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed nav mesh in all maps with teleportation. 
[*]Fixed swapping items between hands. 
[*]Fixed collision issues with various apartment meshes. 
[*]Fixed healthbar on guns in shooter game.
[*]Removed some unnecessary dynamic effects from both the tutorial and main base vending machine level that improved performance A LOT. 
[*]Fixed sound concurrency for certain physics objects. 
[/list]

[h2][b]Added Inputs[/b][/h2]
I added inputs for the Valve Index and Oculus. I won't go as far as to say they're actually supported since I can't test them myself but the inputs are hooked up... They should wooooork? For the most part. Give it a shot if you have one of those but like I said, not actually supported. With that you can switch the controls board in the starting room to view your devices controls.

Coffee VendoR is getting there, just a couple more updates until I'm satisfied. It's been a long journey, thanks for everyones support during it!

-Leland <3
